messages:
Maya: Heads up: QuantaForge (acct QF-77) disputed INV-5102 (May). They claim a burst of test jobs hit production embeddings and are asking to split $7,450 over 45 days.
Diego: Can we get the usage dump and model ids? need to verify which SKU was billed.
Maya: Invoice + logs: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-5102  https://logs.redwood.example/qf-77/usage/2026-05
Ivy: CS spoke with them — finance willing to pay 30% today, remainder in three equal payments. They request no service disruption and an official payment plan doc.
Tom: Collections stance: require initial payment + signed plan to pause escalation. Recommend we also request a temporary soft throttle to prevent repeated bursts.
legal-bot: If accepting installments, include clause: customer withdraws dispute and waives chargebacks for amount covered by the plan. I can produce a 1-paragraph addendum.
Diego: Quick log scan: extra traffic to redwood/embed-small-v1 between 01:10-02:05 UTC on 2026-05-11; approximate extra tokens ~1.1M. Will confirm numbers.
Maya: Proposed terms: 30% now, then 3x equal payments every 15 days, waive one late fee grace, require signed ack. Offer a 5% one-time goodwill credit if all payments on time.
Ivy: Customer agreed to 30% today on our call if we send the doc now. Tom please send invoice link and plan template.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 3rd_notice sent to QF-77 for INV-5102 at 2005551250. Next action: account hold in 5 days.
Tom: Sent invoice link and payment plan PDF. Awaiting e-signature and payment. Will update thread.
Diego: Finalized token counts: 1,092,180 tokens to redwood/embed-small-v1 in spike window. No evidence of test key usage. Posting CSV to secure share.
Maya: If we get initial payment + signed addendum, Collections will mark invoice On Payment Plan and delay hold. Ivy, confirm when they pay.
Ivy: They just paid 30% via card. Received signed addendum via DocuSign. Updating status now.
collections-bot: Payment received: partial $2,235 for INV-5102 at 2005551399. Invoice status set to On Payment Plan.
Maya: Thanks team. Diego please file a ticket for metering rule review (spike protection for connectors). Closing thread for now; will reopen on missed payment.
